coverage_notes: Comprehensive survey spanning foundational HCI theory, peer-reviewed empirical studies, and practitioner guidelines for human-AI interaction design. Coverage includes: (1) The seminal Amershi et al. CHI 2019 Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction (18 principles) plus validation studies; (2) Foundational HCI authors (Shneiderman's Human-Centered AI framework, Norman's design psychology, Tufte's information design, Munzner's visualization); (3) Systematic literature reviews and survey papers on HCI+AI intersection from 2023-2025; (4) Peer-reviewed research from top venues (CHI, UIST, TOCHI, IUI) covering trust, explainability, mental models, user control, team performance, co-design, onboarding, and accessibility; (5) Design guidebooks and frameworks (Google PAIR, Microsoft guidelines, design pattern catalogs); (6) Domain-specific research (decision support, creative collaboration, recommendation systems, healthcare); (7) Interaction design patterns and dark patterns; (8) User research methodologies and validation approaches. Deduplication applied across multiple search angles. Notable gaps: limited coverage of low-code/workflow tools specifically (though agent/workflow papers present), limited coverage of non-English sources, paywalled analyst reports excluded. Total: 48 high-confidence sources spanning T0-T3 tiers.

sources.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
sources.notes: Seminal CHI 2019 paper by Amershi et al. presenting 18 design guidelines for human-AI interaction, validated through 3 rounds of evaluation with 49 design practitioners against 20 AI products. Core reference for the field.

sources.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction (PDF)
sources.notes: PDF version of the Amershi et al. guidelines from Microsoft Research. Contains the full text of the 18 principles and validation methodology.

sources.title: Human-Centered AI: Reliable, Safe & Trustworthy (Book)
sources.notes: Oxford University Press book by Ben Shneiderman on the HCAI framework for designing AI systems that augment human capabilities. Foundational text on human-centered AI philosophy.

sources.title: People + AI Research (PAIR) Guidebook
sources.notes: Google's practical toolkit for building human-centered AI products. Covers design principles, patterns, and recommendations validated across Google product teams and academic research. Widely adopted by practitioners.

sources.title: PAIR Guidebook: Errors + Graceful Failure
sources.notes: PAIR chapter on error handling and failure recovery patterns in AI systems. Emphasizes graceful degradation and user communication during system failures.

sources.title: Does the Whole Exceed its Parts? The Effect of AI Explanations on Complementary Team Performance
sources.notes: CHI 2021 empirical study by Bansal, Wu, Zhou et al. on whether explanations improve human-AI team performance. Found that explanations increased reliance regardless of AI correctness, raising questions about appropriate trust.

sources.title: Assessing Human-AI Interaction Early through Factorial Surveys: A Study on the Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
sources.notes: TOCHI paper validating Amershi guidelines early in design using factorial survey methodology with 49 design practitioners. Demonstrates applicability across diverse AI contexts.

sources.title: Survey of User Interface Design and Interaction Techniques in Generative AI Applications
sources.notes: Comprehensive 2024 arXiv survey systematizing UI/UX design patterns for generative AI. Creates design compendium for practitioners, identifying current state of practice.

sources.title: An HCI-Centric Survey and Taxonomy of Human-Generative-AI Interactions
sources.notes: arXiv systematic taxonomy from HCI perspective analyzing human-generative-AI interactions. Covers interaction design techniques and patterns specific to GenAI.

sources.title: A Systematic Literature Review of Human-Centered, Ethical, and Responsible AI
sources.notes: Comprehensive systematic review synthesizing research on human-centered AI design, ethics, and responsible development from HCI perspective.

sources.title: Towards Human-Centered Explainable AI: A Survey of User Studies for Model Explanations
sources.notes: Survey analyzing 97 papers with user studies on model explanations from HCI and XAI venues (CHI, IUI, UIST, CSCW, etc.). Systematic review of explainability evaluation methods.

sources.title: From Explainable to Interactive AI: A Literature Review on Current Trends in Human-AI Interaction
sources.notes: Literature review examining shift from explainable AI to interactive AI approaches. Analyzes bottlenecks in HCI+AI research and practice.

sources.title: A Systematic Literature Review of User Trust in AI-Enabled Systems: An HCI Perspective
sources.notes: Systematic review from HCI perspective on how users develop trust in AI systems. Covers antecedents, mechanisms, and measurement of trust.

sources.title: Interaction Design: Beyond Human-Computer Interaction (6th Edition)
sources.notes: Foundational HCI textbook by Preece, Rogers, Sharp. Latest edition includes chapters on AI and data science with emphasis on human-centered AI design.

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things (Design Psychology Principles)
sources.notes: Foundational work by Don Norman on interaction design, affordances, and user mental models. Core concepts apply to AI interface design.

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
sources.notes: Tamara Munzner's foundational work on visualization design and interaction. Nested model and What-Why-How framework applicable to AI visualization and data presentation.

sources.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
sources.notes: Edward Tufte's seminal work on data visualization. Principles of clarity, data-ink ratio, and graphical integrity foundational for presenting AI model outputs and uncertainty.

sources.title: Design for AI: Understanding Mental Models
sources.notes: IBM Design article on eliciting and designing for user mental models in AI systems. Practical methodology for understanding user expectations.

sources.title: Understanding User Mental Models in AI-Driven Code Completion Tools: Insights from an Elicitation Study
sources.notes: Empirical study eliciting user mental models of AI capabilities and limitations in code completion tools. Methodology and findings on mental model alignment.

sources.title: Exploring Human-AI Collaboration Using Mental Models of Early Adopters of Multi-Agent Generative AI Tools
sources.notes: Study of how users develop mental models when collaborating with multi-agent GenAI systems. Identifies key dimensions of user understanding.

sources.title: Design Principles for Generative AI Applications
sources.notes: CHI 2024 paper presenting 6 design principles specific to generative AI, validated through design workshops with 33 UX practitioners. Addresses unique challenges of GenAI UX.

sources.title: Toward General Design Principles for Generative AI Applications
sources.notes: Early work on design principles for GenAI applications. Addresses variability, controllability, and user expectations for generative systems.

sources.title: Human-in-the-Loop Design Cycles: A Process Framework that Integrates Design Sprints, Agile Processes, and Machine Learning with Humans
sources.notes: Framework for integrating human feedback into ML development cycles. Process-oriented approach to human-AI collaboration in systems design.

sources.title: Human-in-the-Loop Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review of Concepts, Methods, and Applications
sources.notes: Comprehensive systematic review of HITL AI covering concepts, methods, applications. Taxonomy of validation approaches and design considerations.

sources.title: Towards Guidelines for Designing Human-in-the-Loop Machine Training Interfaces
sources.notes: IUI paper on design guidelines for interfaces enabling human feedback in ML training. Addresses annotation, validation, and active learning interaction patterns.

sources.title: Unpacking Human-AI Interactions: From Interaction Primitives to a Design Space
sources.notes: Systematic decomposition of human-AI interactions into primitives. Creates design space for analyzing and designing AI interaction patterns.

sources.title: Characterizing and Modeling Harms from Interactions with Design Patterns in AI Interfaces
sources.notes: Analyzes harmful design patterns in AI interfaces (dark patterns, anthropomorphism, explainability failures). Taxonomy of AI-specific interaction harms.

sources.title: Exploring User Expectations of Proactive AI Systems
sources.notes: In-the-wild study examining user expectations of proactive AI systems at different automation levels. Empirical findings on appropriate proactivity.

sources.title: Expectation Management in AI: A Framework for Understanding Stakeholder Trust and Acceptance
sources.notes: Framework validated in healthcare and education for managing stakeholder expectations of AI. Addresses disconnect between user expectations and system capabilities.

sources.title: Will You Accept an Imperfect AI? Exploring Designs for Adjusting End-user Expectations of AI Systems
sources.notes: Study on how expectation adjustment designs improve user acceptance of imperfect AI. Identifies techniques for setting realistic mental models.

sources.title: Collaborating with AI Agents: Field Experiments on Teamwork, Productivity, and Performance
sources.notes: Large-scale field experiment (2,234 participants) comparing human-human vs. human-AI team performance on creative tasks. Findings on delegation, communication, and output quality.

sources.title: Investigating AI Teammate Communication Strategies and Their Impact in Human-AI Teams for Effective Teamwork
sources.notes: Empirical study identifying communication strategies for AI teammates. Examines how AI communication (proactive, guiding) affects team performance and coordination.

sources.title: Practising Appropriate Trust in Human-Centred AI Design
sources.notes: CHI Extended Abstracts paper on designing for appropriate (calibrated) trust. Argues for informative explanations over convincing ones.

sources.title: Collaborative Human-AI Trust (CHAI-T): A Process Framework for Active Management of Trust
sources.notes: Framework for actively managing trust in human-AI collaboration through process design. Provides structured approach to trust calibration.

sources.title: Designing for Appropriate Reliance: The Roles of AI Uncertainty Presentation, Initial User Decision, and User Demographics
sources.notes: Study on how uncertainty visualization affects user reliance on AI. Finds calibrated frequency presentations more effective than raw probabilities.

sources.title: Understanding Uncertainty: How Lay Decision-makers Perceive and Interpret Uncertainty in Human-AI Decision Making
sources.notes: IUI study on how non-experts interpret AI uncertainty. Examines different uncertainty communication methods and their effects on decision-making.

sources.title: What is AI Literacy? Competencies and Design Considerations
sources.notes: CHI 2020 paper defining AI literacy as competency framework. Identifies what users need to know to interact effectively with AI.

sources.title: Evaluating AI-Assisted Creative Ideation: A Crossover Study in Higher Education
sources.notes: Empirical study comparing human-only vs. AI-assisted brainstorming. Identifies patterns in how students use AI during creative tasks.

sources.title: Exploring Creativity in Human-AI Co-creation: A Comparative Study Across Design Experience
sources.notes: Comparative study of creative collaboration dynamics between novice and expert designers with AI. Analyzes creativity metrics and co-creation patterns.

sources.title: Trust-Inspiring Explanation Interfaces for Recommender Systems
sources.notes: Foundational work on designing explanations for recommendation systems to build user trust. Identifies UI design elements that affect trust perception.

sources.title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey of RLHF methodologies covering feedback collection, reward modeling, and policy optimization. Reviews interaction design for preference feedback.

sources.title: Design Principles for Human-Agent Interaction
sources.notes: Systematizes design principles for human-agent systems. Emphasizes transparency, communication, and appropriate autonomy levels.

sources.title: On the Design of and Interaction with Conversational Agents: An Organizing and Assessing Review of HCI Research
sources.notes: Comprehensive HCI review of conversational agent design. Systematizes interaction design research for chatbots and dialogue systems.

sources.title: How Do Users Interact with Algorithm Recommender Systems? The Interaction of Users, Algorithms, and Performance
sources.notes: Study of user interaction patterns with recommendation algorithms. Examines how users learn and adapt to system behavior over time.

sources.title: Design Considerations for Human Oversight of AI: Insights from Co-Design Workshops and Work Design Theory
sources.notes: Co-design study yielding design considerations for oversight interfaces. Combines HCI and work design perspectives on human-AI control.

sources.title: Human-Centered Explainable AI (HCXAI): Re-examining Explainability in the Era of Agentic AI for CHI 2026
sources.notes: CHI 2026 workshop on explainability in agentic AI. Represents current research frontier in XAI+HCI. 6th iteration with 450+ participants from 21 countries.

sources.title: A Multidisciplinary Survey and Framework for Design and Evaluation of Explainable AI Systems
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey synthesizing design and evaluation approaches for explainable AI. Spans computer science, psychology, HCI perspectives.

sources.title: User-Centered Evaluation of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI): A Systematic Literature Review
sources.notes: 2024 Wiley systematic review of 101 user studies on XAI evaluation from 3414 papers. Identifies evaluation methods and metrics for user-centered XAI.

sources.title: Human-AI Interaction Design Standards
sources.notes: Recent paper (2025) proposing comprehensive design standards for human-AI interaction. Synthesizes guidelines and proposes structured framework.

sources.title: The Future of Human-AI Collaboration: A Taxonomy of Design Knowledge for Hybrid Intelligence Systems
sources.notes: Proposes taxonomy of design knowledge for hybrid human-AI intelligence systems. Frames AI as augmentation tool, not replacement.

sources.title: The Shape of AI: UX Patterns for Artificial Intelligence Design
sources.notes: Interactive pattern library for AI UX design. Documents interaction patterns for confidence, uncertainty, feedback, and user control.

sources.title: Feedback by Design: Understanding and Overcoming User Feedback Barriers in Conversational Agents
sources.notes: Study on how conversational interface design affects user ability to provide feedback. Identifies barriers and design solutions.

sources.title: AI Agent Behavioral Science
sources.notes: Framework for understanding agent behavior in human-AI interaction. Covers how agents adapt and respond to feedback.

sources.title: The User-First Approach to AI Ethics: Preferences for Ethical Principles in AI Systems Across Cultures and Contexts
sources.notes: Study of user preferences for ethical principles in AI across cultures. Emphasizes need for context-aware, participatory ethics design.

sources.title: AI Literacy for Community Colleges: Instructors' Perspectives on Scenario-Based and Interactive Approaches
sources.notes: Research on teaching AI literacy through scenario-based interactive approaches. Identifies effective pedagogies for diverse learners.

sources.title: A Design Trajectory Map of Human-AI Collaborative Reinforcement Learning Systems: Survey and Taxonomy
sources.notes: Survey and taxonomy of human-AI collaborative RL system designs. Maps design space for interaction in learning systems.
